decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w1' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.3087. Series context: trend strength 0.9943 and seasonal strength 0.0879; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.267); 7 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 34.832.
